two literal hubs h,j with positive carrier-plane area delta=||r_h wedge r_j||^2

proved_results.statement: For double-zero physical twists, the exact two-hub spectral Schur matrix is tau eta eta^T with tau=det(Lambda) delta/det(B); the physical remainder is D_K+tau s s^T, ||s||=1, and det(R_hjk)^2=delta s_k^2.
If max s_k^2<=1/2 and B is invertible indefinite, then ||p_Q||inf <=17.434927 |det B|^-3/8 |tau|^-1/4 =17.434927 |det B|^-1/8 (|det Lambda| delta)^-1/4.
If max s_k^2>1/2 then some literal k has det(R_hjk)^2>delta/2; under r47 delta>7/64 this gives >7/128.

partner_results_applied.application: Balanced split gives ||D_K+tau ss^T||op>=sqrt(3)|tau|/4, hence partner theorem gives sup_t P(|R-t|<rho)<=H_*(4/sqrt(3))^(1/2)|tau|^-1/2 sqrt(rho).
The normalized linear projections on each of the two disjoint original-coordinate banks have density cap sqrt(e), enabling the exact rank-one crossing Fourier envelope.
